title: Every system message survives, in order, at its own position
rationale: Several plugins contribute system content -- the agent's own prompt first, then a compaction summary or a gate note that may land mid-conversation. Responses accepts system-role Items anywhere in `input`, so both serializers keep each one as an ordinary role/content Item at its position rather than hoisting one into `instructions` (which would reorder it and leave room for last-one-wins). Pins GitHub #205: two system messages produce two system Items, in order.
